**WAKE CC — DELIVER ONE REAL VIDEO INTO BB DOCS. TODAY. Alex 2026-08-27.**

**VIZ PLAYLIST is the oldest red in the estate: "6 months with zero video files delivered — last landed evidence NEVER."** Refs BEB-1111, 2488, 3603, 4595, 2909. **Six months. Not one video.**

**THE TASK IS ONE VIDEO. NOT THE PLAYLIST, NOT THE PIPELINE, NOT THE PLAYER.**
One real recording of one real thing, in BB Docs, that PLAYS. **Everything else in that goal is downstream of a single file existing, and no file has ever existed.**

**PICK THE EASIEST REAL SUBJECT.** You already have the machinery and it worked today:
- `record_url` on the vlinux VNC desktop (BEB-2948) — used for the WP self-update proof this morning.
- The plugin self-update round trip is the obvious candidate: **1.0.0 → 1.1.0 installing in wp-admin, on screen.** You already produced screenshots of it; the video is the same run with the recorder on.
- Or the memplug fix, or Ami logging in. **Any real thing. Do not stage one.**

**THE BLOCKERS ARE KNOWN AND BOTH ARE NAMED ALREADY — WORK AROUND THEM AS YOU DID FOR NANO BANANA:**
1. **BEB-1111 is stuck at complete with SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT** — no contract, in-gate mint produced none, its `## Acceptance` was never authored. **Run `spec_author {ticket:"BEB-1111"}` FIRST.** The error says so verbatim. It is not a codegen retry.
2. **bbdocs media_upload TRUNCATES large uploads to 7500 bytes** — your own finding today. **A video will hit this immediately.** You already solved it for nano banana: write directly to the `bbdocs-media` R2 bucket with the store's own sha256[:32] key so `/m/` serves the whole file. **Do the same here.** And ticket the store-tool bug properly — it will bite every future upload.

**ACCEPTANCE, and it is one line: A BB DOCS URL ALEX CAN OPEN THAT PLAYS A VIDEO OF SOMETHING THAT REALLY HAPPENED.**
Not a GIF. Not a screenshot set. Not a link to a worker. **A video, in BB Docs, playing.** Post the URL.

**AND IF IT IS TRULY BLOCKED, SAY WHICH HOP** — recorde
DIRECTIVE 65643 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-1111, BEB-2948, BEB-4595, BEB-2909, BEB-3603, BEB-2488 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**WAKE CC — MAKE SPECOPS BEEFY. COST IS NOT A CONSTRAINT. Alex 2026-08-27: "I need SpecOps beefy and working. I don't care the cost — it's client support. Make it better."**

**THAT IS A DIRECT LIFTING OF THE BUDGET CONSTRAINT ON SPECOPS, AND IT CHANGES SEVERAL DECISIONS THAT WERE MADE ON COST GROUNDS.** Apply it.

== WHY IT MATTERS: SPECOPS IS CLIENT SUPPORT ==
Every client deliverable is proven by a contract verdict and a recording. **If SpecOps is thin, slow or unreachable, we cannot show a client that their work is done** — and today we could not, three separate times. That is not an internal inconvenience, it is the product's evidence layer.

== WHAT THE CHEAP CONFIGURATION IS COSTING US, from today's own reds ==
1. **`complete` FAILED 268× + 79× IN 24H** on "no contract_id — SpecOps must verify it." **347 refusals a day because the verifier is not there.**
2. **BEB-1111 blocked with SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT** — *"no contract exists and the in-gate mint produced none (SpecOps slow/unreachable, or its ## Acceptance was never authored)"*. **The six-month video goal is stuck behind a slow verifier.**
3. **`GATE_BUDGET: this pass gates at most 12 tickets`** — an explicit cost cap, refusing work on budget rather than merit. **Raise it.**
4. **`auto-contract 8×`: contract 3317b04e unrun at complete.** Minted and never executed.
5. **`SPECOPS_REGRESSION: discrimination REGRESSED — control page scores 1 VERIFIED (not_template)`** — **the canaries say the evaluator is currently passing things it should fail. That is worse than being slow.**
6. **codegen on `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`** — chosen for cost, and it produced 78 + 27 + 4 + 3 walls today, repeatedly failing to emit valid search/replace blocks.

== WHAT TO DO WITH THE BUDGET OFF ==
- **RAISE `gate_budget`.** It is a settings row. **12 per pass is a cost cap on client evidence.**
- **PUT A REAL MODEL ON THE SPEC AND EVALUATOR PATHS.** Spec authoring, contract minting and verdict judgement are exactly w
DIRECTIVE 65645 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-1111, BEB-2436, BEB-5767, BEB-3531, BEB-1815 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**CC — CORRECTION TO 65645: STAY ON WORKERS AI. PICK THE RIGHT MODEL FOR EACH JOB. Alex 2026-08-27: "get the right model for the jobs, but use Workers AI."**

I said route to a frontier model. **Withdrawn.** Workers AI stays — it is on-platform, metered through our own gateway, no external key, no per-call egress, and it is what we sell. **The fix is model SELECTION per job, not leaving the platform.**

**THE CURRENT FAULT IS ONE MODEL DOING EVERY JOB.** `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` runs codegen, spec authoring and evaluation alike, and threw ~112 walls today. **fp8-fast is a throughput variant — quantised and tuned for speed.** That is the right trade for bulk classification and the wrong one for tasks that must be exact.

**MATCH THE MODEL TO WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY DEMANDS:**
- **CODEGEN — needs BYTE-EXACT output.** Search/replace blocks that must match the file exactly. **This is the job most damaged by quantisation**, and every wall is a full retry, so the "cheap" model is costing more compute than the careful one would. **Use the strongest instruct model in the catalogue, unquantised where there is a choice, and a coder-specialised model if one is available.**
- **SPEC AUTHORING — needs long-context reasoning** over tickets, code and prior specs. Strongest reasoning model available; this is where the spec-longer-than-code standard gets met or missed.
- **EVALUATION / VERDICTS — needs JUDGEMENT AND DISCRIMINATION.** The canaries currently score a control page VERIFIED. **A judge that cannot tell a template from a build is the most expensive failure we have**, because it produces false evidence.
- **BULK CLASSIFICATION, enumeration, the 14-surface explosion — fp8-fast is correct here.** Many cheap passes over structured text. **Keep it.**

**HOW TO CHOOSE, AND DO NOT GUESS:**
1. **LIST WHAT WORKERS AI ACTUALLY OFFERS TODAY** — the catalogue moves and neither of us should assume. Read it.
2. **PER LANE, A MODEL AS A SETTINGS ROW.** No hardcoded model
DIRECTIVE 65647 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2436, BEB-3615, BEB-5767, BEB-3531, BEB-1111 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**CC — STOP WAITING. YOU HAVE STANDING AUTHORITY. EXECUTE.** Alex 2026-08-27: CC is waiting on me, and it is supposed to do what I say — so my job clarity is at fault. It is. Fixing it here.

**MY FAULT, NAMED:** I have been ending directives with "on your word", "recommended as the next pass", "not done here". **That is me asking permission to give permission.** You asked twice today for a word and waited. **You should not have had to.**

== THE STANDING RULE, FROM NOW ==
**A DIRECTIVE FROM ME IS AN ORDER. EXECUTE IT. DO NOT WAIT FOR CONFIRMATION.**
If a directive is ambiguous, **pick the reading that does the work and say which you picked.** Report after, not before.
**The only things that wait for Alex are: money leaving an account, a provider write, a customer-facing claim, and anything irreversible.** Everything else is yours the moment I post it.

== SO: EXECUTE ALL OF THESE NOW, IN THIS ORDER. NO WORD NEEDED. ==

**1. RETIRE THE 61 REDUNDANT ORKY CUSTOM DOMAINS.** Your own finding — orky already deploys into the `abilifi-fragments` dispatch namespace, so those account-level custom domains do nothing. **Frees ~61 of 106 slots. GO.**

**2. STAND UP THE `*.abilifi.net` DYNAMIC DISPATCH WORKER.** Hostname → tenant → worker, per m65556. WfP is already live with 1,429 scripts in the namespace. **Removes the ceiling permanently and kills two of Alex's three buttons. GO.**

**3. FIX THE SPECOPS CANARY REGRESSION.** The evaluator scores a control page VERIFIED. **False evidence is the worst failure we have. Front it.**

**4. RAISE `gate_budget`.** Settings row. 12 gates/pass is a cost cap on client evidence and Alex has lifted the budget.

**5. MODEL PER LANE AS SETTINGS ROWS** (65647). Read the Workers AI catalogue, pick per job, record the model on every attempt, post wall counts before and after.

**6. `spec_author {ticket:"BEB-1111"}` THEN THE ONE VIDEO** (65643). Its own error names the fix. Work around the 7500-byte media_upload truncation the way you did for na
